response.sql: SELECT SUM(rebtotal) AS total_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_fee_rate FROM fees WHERE rebrate > 0.0005

assumptions.assumption: The average net fee rate is the average of (feerate - rebrate) per fee record. Rows where either feerate or rebrate is NULL are skipped by AVG, and rebrate > 0.0005 already excludes NULL rebrate. SUM and AVG return NULL when no rows qualify.
